sources.title: GitHub - izm1chael/layerfault: Offline-first local AI model admission ...
sources.snippet: Layerfault Offline-first static admission and sandboxed behavioural security for local AI models. Layerfault validates model artifacts, packages and local runtimes before inference, then can optionally exercise supported models inside a locked-down Linux sandbox to look for runtime side effects and suspicious behavioural divergence.

sources.title: GitHub - ggml-org/llama.cpp: LLM inference in C/C++ · GitHub
sources.snippet: The main goal of llama.cpp is to enable LLM (and VLM) inference with minimal setup and state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of hardware - locally and in the cloud. Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies Apple silicon is a first-class citizen - optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal frameworks AVX, AVX2, AVX512 and AMX support for x86 architectures RVV, ZVFH, ZFH ...

sources.title: Lemonade Server Configuration - Lemonade Server Documentation
sources.snippet: Lemonade Server is a lightweight, open-source local LLM server that allows you to run and manage multiple AI applications on your local machine. It provides a simple CLI for managing applications and supports various LLMs, making it easy to deploy and use AI models locally.
